description: Defines data structures, constants, and message formats related to NR-U (New Radio Unlicensed) protocol messages, including discard blocks, lost SN ranges, user data, delivery status, assistance info, and message encapsulation for UL and DL messages.

classes.name: nru_pdcp_sn_discard_block
classes.description: Represents a block of consecutive NR PDCP SNs to be discarded, with start SN and size.

classes.name: nru_lost_nru_sn_range
classes.description: Represents a range of lost NR-U sequence numbers with start and end.

classes.name: nru_dl_user_data
classes.description: Contains flags and parameters for NR-U downlink user data, including polling, retransmission, and discard info.

classes.name: nru_dl_message
classes.description: Encapsulates a downlink message with a transport PDU and associated user data.

classes.name: nru_dl_data_delivery_status
classes.description: Contains delivery status info such as buffer size, data rate, lost SN ranges, and delivery feedback.

classes.name: nru_assistance_information
classes.description: Placeholder for NR-U assistance info, not implemented.

classes.name: nru_ul_message
classes.description: Encapsulates an uplink message with optional PDU, delivery status, and assistance info.

methods.name: deep_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the message or data structure, copying nested buffers and data.
